private static RegMask ThreeBitEncodingToRegMask(byte val) =>
    (val & 0x7) switch
    {
        0x0 => RegMask.EAX,
        0x1 => RegMask.ECX,
        0x2 => RegMask.EDX,
        0x3 => RegMask.EBX,
        0x4 => RegMask.ESP,
        0x5 => RegMask.EBP,
        0x6 => RegMask.ESI,
        0x7 => RegMask.EDI,
        _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(val), $"Not expected register value: {val}"),
    };
